# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 13 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 13:4 — nachalei Beliyya'al: "torrents of Belial" vs. "floods of Belial" vs. "Belial's floodwaters"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "torrents of Belial" | Literal: nachal = torrent/wadi |
| LOGOS | "floods of Belial" | Formal simplification |
| PNEUMA | "Belial's floodwaters" | Possessive construction |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "torrents of Belial" -- "torrent" preserves the wadi imagery and echoes Psalm 18:5.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 13:8 — "torrents of pitch" vs. "rivers of pitch" vs. "rivers of tar"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "torrents of pitch" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "rivers of pitch" | Slight variation |
| PNEUMA | "rivers of tar" | Dynamic -- "tar" for modern readers |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "torrents of pitch" -- "pitch" (zefet) is the standard biblical term.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 13:13 — "roar of His strength" vs. "tumult of His power" vs. "full force of His strength"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "roar of His strength" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "tumult of His power" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "full force of His strength" | Dynamic amplification |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "roar of His strength" -- most direct.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 13:18 — "eternal height" vs. "eternal summit" vs. "a height that lasts forever"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "eternal height" | Standard |
| LOGOS | "eternal summit" | More specific |
| PNEUMA | "a height that lasts forever" | Periphrastic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "eternal height" -- consistent with Column 12.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 13:20 — sod: "eternal council" vs. "eternal assembly" vs. "eternal council"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "eternal council" | sod = intimate council |
| LOGOS | "eternal assembly" | Assembly (broader) |
| PNEUMA | "eternal council" | Matches EMET |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "eternal council" -- consistent with Column 12 ruling.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/PNEUMA.

---

## 13:27 — "stylus of remembrance" vs. "pen of remembrance" vs. "pen of memory"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "stylus of remembrance" | Literal: et = stylus/engraving tool |
| LOGOS | "pen of remembrance" | Simpler English |
| PNEUMA | "pen of memory" | Simplified further |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "stylus of remembrance" -- et refers to an engraving tool; the permanence matters theologically.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 13:33 — "service of iniquity" vs. "labor of iniquity" vs. "drudgery of sin"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "service of iniquity" | Literal: avodah = service/work |
| LOGOS | "labor of iniquity" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "drudgery of sin" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "service of iniquity" -- avodah has cultic overtones creating an ironic contrast.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

**Total disagreements for Column 13:** 7
